packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates once CI is green
Nuxt and Nuxt UI move together and need a Node engine check
prBodyNotes: Review this PR on its own. Nuxt 4.6.1 requires Node `^22.22.3 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0` (Node 24.13 is too old). Ship `@nuxt/ui` 4.11 with Nuxt 4.6. Do not set `future.compatibilityVersion: 5` in the same change. Keep server handlers on `h3` imports.

packageRules.description: Pinia 4 and @pinia/nuxt 1 must be upgraded together
prBodyNotes: Upgrade to Pinia 4.0.3 or newer together with `@pinia/nuxt` 1.x, and add direct dependency `@vue/devtools-api` `^8.1.5`. Pinia 4.0.0 through 4.0.2 crash the Nuxt prerender of `/`.
`@nuxt/test-utils` 3 only accepts Vitest 3. Move to Vitest 5 and `@nuxt/test-utils` 4 in the same PR. `@nuxt/test-utils` is a Nuxt module, so this also affects `nuxt dev` and the Vercel build.

packageRules.description: TypeScript 7 cannot run vue-tsc or typescript-eslint yet
prBodyNotes: Do not merge TypeScript 7.0. It does not ship the programmatic compiler API that `vue-tsc` (`pnpm typecheck`) and `@nuxt/eslint` need. Stay on 6.x until those tools support it.

packageRules.description: Auth cookie behavior can change with @supabase/ssr
prBodyNotes: 2.0.10 only bumps dependencies, but it moves `@supabase/ssr` from `^0.10.3` to `^0.12.4`. Re-test login, confirm, and session cookies before merging.
